description: Resolve DNS records for a domain using Google's DoH resolver. Returns A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, SOA, PTR, CAA, or SRV records as structured JSON. Use this as the default DNS lookup tool — it requires no API key.

domain.description: Target domain (e.g., example.com). Lowercase, no trailing dot.

name: dns_lookup
